captions.detailed: A portable shoulder-style mini camcorder modeled in a dark grey/black matte finish. It features a main boxy camera body, a forward-projecting cylindrical lens tube, a rounded battery pack bulge at the rear, a top carrying handle, and a small grey selector dial. On the left side, a flat rectangular LCD screen panel is designed to swing open on a vertical hinge, and a cassette compartment door is situated below it.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a shoulder-style mini camcorder with a dark grey body, a forward-facing cylindrical lens tube, a rounded rear battery compartment, and a top carrying handle. Include an LCD display panel on the left side that articulates on a vertical revolute joint, a lower tape-compartment door on a horizontal revolute joint, and a rotatable selector dial on the top deck.
captions.factory: Construct the main camera body using a Boolean union of a box and a cylinder. Attach a cylindrical lens assembly to the front and a rounded box for the battery compartment at the rear. Model the top handle using a box combined with vertical support posts. Define three articulated parts: an LCD screen panel on a vertical revolute hinge, a tape door on a horizontal revolute hinge, and a top selector dial using a continuous rotational joint.
